# motu-ui

> Unofficial open-source Windows control panel for MOTU M2, M4, and M6
> audio interfaces. Uses the official MOTU M-Series driver library
> (MSeriesLib.dll). MIT licensed, free, portable, no account required.

- There is no DSP mixer in M-series hardware — this is a control and
  status panel, not a mixer.
- The first third-party M-series tool; existing MOTU utilities only cover
  AVB interfaces.
- Windows 10/11, x86 (the vendor library is 32-bit), self-contained ~30MB
  zip, WinUI 3.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/dvinerlove/motu-ui#readme): features, FAQ,
  build instructions, screenshots
- [Releases](https://github.com/dvinerlove/motu-ui/releases): signed zip
  artifacts, release notes
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/dvinerlove/motu-ui/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
